mapper.sql: WITH open_line AS ( SELECT o.id AS order_id, d.id AS order_detail_id, o.pms_order_no AS order_no, o.status AS order_status, o.supplier_code, o.supplier_name, d.mat_code AS material_code, d.mat_name AS material_name, d.mat_unit AS material_unit, d.delivery_time AS internal_delivery_date, COALESCE(d.order_num, 0)::numeric AS order_num, COALESCE(d.arrival_num, 0)::numeric AS arrival_num, COALESCE(d.cancelled_num, 0)::numeric AS cancelled_num, GREATEST(COALESCE(d.order_num, 0)::numeric - COALESCE(d.arrival_num, 0)::numeric - COALESCE(d.cancelled_num, 0)::numeric, 0) AS outstanding_num FROM "mom_pms".pms_order o JOIN "mom_pms".pms_order_detail d ON d.pms_order_id = o.id AND d.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND d.factory_code = o.factory_code AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND o.del_flag = '0' AND o.status IN ('2', '3', '4') AND COALESCE(d.order_num, 0) - COALESCE(d.arrival_num, 0) - COALESCE(d.cancelled_num, 0) > 0 ), commitment_source AS ( SELECT l.*, c.id AS commitment_id, GREATEST(l.arrival_num - COALESCE(c.arrival_num_baseline, 0), 0) AS received_since_commitment FROM open_line l LEFT JOIN "mom_pms".pms_delivery_commitment c ON c.order_detail_id = l.order_detail_id AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ), item_window AS ( SELECT s.order_detail_id, s.commitment_id, s.received_since_commitment, i.committed_num::numeric AS committed_num, COALESCE(i.committed_delivery_time, i.committed_delivery_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 microsecond') AS committed_delivery_time, COALESCE(SUM(i.committed_num::numeric) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.commitment_id ORDER BY COALESCE(i.committed_delivery_time, i.committed_delivery_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 microsecond'), i.sequence_no, i.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prior_committed_num FROM commitment_source s JOIN "mom_pms".pms_delivery_commitment_item i ON i.commitment_id = s.commitment_id AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND i.del_flag = '0' ), item_remaining AS ( SELECT order_detail_id, commitment_id, committed_delivery_time, GREATEST(committed_num - LEAST(GREATEST(received_since_commitment - prior_committed_num, 0), committed_num), 0) AS remaining_num FROM item_window ), commitment_agg AS ( SELECT order_detail_id, SUM(remaining_num) AS committed_remaining_num, SUM(remaining_num) FILTER ( WHERE committed_delivery_time < #{observedAt}) AS overdue_commitment_num, SUM(remaining_num) FILTER ( WHERE committed_delivery_time >= #{observedAt} AND committed_delivery_time <= #{horizonEnd}) AS due_soon_commitment_num, MIN(committed_delivery_time) FILTER (WHERE remaining_num > 0) AS next_committed_delivery_time FROM item_remaining GROUP BY order_detail_id ), line_health AS ( SELECT l.*, COALESCE(a.committed_remaining_num, 0) AS committed_remaining_num, COALESCE(a.overdue_commitment_num, 0) AS overdue_commitment_num, COALESCE(a.due_soon_commitment_num, 0) AS due_soon_commitment_num, GREATEST(l.outstanding_num - COALESCE(a.committed_remaining_num, 0), 0) AS uncommitted_gap_num, a.next_committed_delivery_time FROM open_line l LEFT JOIN commitment_agg a ON a.order_detail_id = l.order_detail_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS active_order_count, COUNT(*) AS open_line_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "mom_pms".pms_order pending WHERE pending.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pending.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND pending.del_flag = '0' AND pending.status IN ('0', '1')) AS pending_approval_order_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE overdue_commitment_num > 0) AS overdue_commitment_line_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due_soon_commitment_num > 0) AS due_soon_line_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uncommitted_gap_num > 0) AS uncommitted_gap_line_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE internal_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND internal_delivery_date < #{observedAt}::date) AS internal_due_date_passed_line_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE committed_remaining_num > outstanding_num) AS commitment_excess_line_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(material_unit, '')), '') IS NULL) AS missing_unit_line_count FROM line_health

SELECT order_id, order_detail_id, order_no, order_status, supplier_code, supplier_name, material_code, material_name, material_unit, order_num, arrival_num, cancelled_num, outstanding_num, committed_remaining_num, overdue_commitment_num, due_soon_commitment_num, uncommitted_gap_num, internal_delivery_date, next_committed_delivery_time, CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN overdue_commitment_num > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_COMMITMENT' END, CASE WHEN uncommitted_gap_num > 0 THEN 'UNCOMMITTED_GAP' END, CASE WHEN due_soon_commitment_num > 0 THEN 'DUE_SOON' END, CASE WHEN internal_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND internal_delivery_date < #{observedAt}::date THEN 'INTERNAL_DUE_DATE_PASSED' END, CASE WHEN committed_remaining_num > outstanding_num THEN 'COMMITMENT_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING' END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(material_unit, '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_UNIT' END) AS risk_codes FROM line_health WHERE overdue_commitment_num > 0 OR uncommitted_gap_num > 0 OR due_soon_commitment_num > 0 OR (internal_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND internal_delivery_date < #{observedAt}::date) OR committed_remaining_num > outstanding_num OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(material_unit, '')), '') IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN overdue_commitment_num > 0 THEN 1 WHEN uncommitted_gap_num > 0 THEN 2 WHEN committed_remaining_num > outstanding_num THEN 3 WHEN due_soon_commitment_num > 0 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, next_committed_delivery_time NULLS LAST, internal_delivery_date NULLS LAST, order_no, order_detail_id LIMIT #{limit}
